summary: Comprehensive testing of Share Meeting feature for AI KARAU Meeting Portal. All backend APIs (10/10) and frontend features (10/10) passed. Guest join page, share dialog, and meeting room share button all work correctly.

backend_api_tests: GET /api/karau-meet/meetings/{id}/info - Public endpoint returns meeting info without auth
GET /api/karau-meet/meetings/INVALID/info - Returns 404 for invalid meeting ID
POST /api/karau-meet/meetings/{id}/join-guest - Guest join with name works
POST /api/karau-meet/meetings/{id}/join-guest - Returns ICE servers for WebRTC
POST /api/karau-meet/meetings - Creates meeting with join_url for sharing
Complete share flow: Create -> Get Info -> Guest Join -> Verify participant
frontend_ui_tests: Guest Join Page shows meeting title from API
Guest Join Page has name input (data-testid='guest-name-input')
Guest Join Page has join button (data-testid='guest-join-btn')
Guest Join Page navigates to meeting room on successful join
Guest Join Page shows 'Meeting Not Found' for invalid meeting IDs
Dashboard shows Share button (share icon) for each meeting
Share button on dashboard opens ShareMeetingDialog
Create Meeting dialog has 'Create & Share' button (data-testid='btn-create-and-share')
Meeting Room header has Share button (data-testid='meeting-share-btn')

critical_code_review_comments: ShareMeetingDialog component properly generates join URL, ICS content, and Google Calendar link client-side
GuestJoinPage correctly fetches meeting info from public /info endpoint without auth
Guest join flow stores guest data in localStorage key 'karau_guest' and navigates to room
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Meeting Room header Share button duplicated (two with same testid) - both work but could be cleaned up
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test meetings via API and UI during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Share Meeting feature is fully functional. Key routes: /karau-meet/join/{meetingId} (Guest Join Page), ShareMeetingDialog component. Public API: GET /api/karau-meet/meetings/{id}/info. Guest join: POST /api/karau-meet/meetings/{id}/join-guest. All data-testids documented in passed tests.

share_button_locations: Dashboard - next to each meeting in Recent Meetings list
